judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a spec, `.lore/dod.md`, and an acceptance test file, without actually implementing any of the production code in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or adding `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, all new tests in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. Additionally, the candidate named the test file `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the required `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`, omitted the orchestrator integration test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and did not actually include an unlisted extra property in its extra-properties test (`units` is in `WEATHER_TOOL.inputSchema`). Finally, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were performed.
